description: PitchBoost builds sales and pitch decks you can actually send. Describe the prospect, the offer and the goal and get a hosted deck with real layout, typography and your brand pulled from your website, plus a link you can share and track. Upload an existing PowerPoint, Google Slides or Keynote deck and PitchBoost rebuilds it in your brand, keeping every slide's content and figures. Every number in the deck is checked against your brief and your sources; anything that cannot be traced is removed before you see it. Without an account you get a watermarked sample deck to evaluate. Connect your PitchBoost account to generate decks in your own workspace, list your recent decks and open any of them for editing, PDF and PowerPoint export.

defaultPrompt: Here is my pitch deck, make it look professional.
Make a sample pitch deck for a coffee subscription startup aimed at seed investors.
List my recent PitchBoost decks and give me the link to the newest one.
